messages.body_plain:
Hi

I just blogged about a project idea to facilitte (and speed up) the data
exchange between GRASS and R (read and write spatial GRASS data from R,
initially raster, but later also vector).

You can read the post at:

http://rmkrug.wordpress.com/2013/07/15/grassrlink-1/

I would very much like to have feedback from your side as I think this
will be a worthwhile exercise.

Cheers,

Rainer
